description: Check whether a license number belongs to a business theoPros lists, which means the license was active on the state board's register on the date in 'checked'. listed=false means it is not in theoPros: theoPros covers only active licenses in its trades and cities, so check the state board before calling it inactive.

licence.description: License number as the board writes it, e.g. '1027925' (CA), '335498' or 'ROC335498' (AZ), 'CCC1328295' (FL)

name: verify_licence
title: Verify a contractor license
